summary: Invivyd filed an 8-K disclosing positive topline results from its LIBERTY Phase 3 study of VYD2311, reporting safety and tolerability clinically and statistically superior to an mRNA-based COVID-19 vaccine, with no interference and added neutralizing titers. The company announced plans for a BLA submission via Accelerated Approval following a Type C meeting, with DECLARATION topline safety and immunogenicity data expected in October. An investor call was scheduled for September 29, 2026. This is a routine clinical/regulatory update, not a special situation; no deal terms or board recommendations are stated.
